source_name: arXiv bulk TeX source — single-version redistributable subset

official_access.source_dataset: Amazon S3 requester-pays arXiv source files
official_access.access_mode: official bulk source TAR chunks plus bulk OAI-PMH metadata; no page-by-page article scraping

scope.original_representation: exact TeX body and exact matched delimiter/environment from the source file
scope.admission_rule: An article is payload-eligible only when arXivRaw reports exactly one version and the paper-level license is an unambiguous redistributable CC BY, CC BY-SA, or CC0 URL. Multi-version records are excluded from payload publication because arXiv states that different versions can carry different licenses while bulk OAI metadata exposes one paper-level/current license.
exclusions: CC BY-NC and CC BY-NC-ND/NC-SA licenses
records with zero or more than one recorded version
math inside TeX comments, verbatim/lstlisting/minted environments, and verb commands
macro expansion, OCR, and prose-to-math reconstruction at extracted stage

snapshot_policy.rule: Pin an exact arXiv source manifest, verify every acquired S3 source TAR against the manifest md5sum, build a deterministic SHA-256 inventory over the exact acquired source chunks, independently inventory the exact OAI-PMH arXivRaw XML used for rights/version decisions, and derive one source_snapshot from both inventory digests. Do not identify a snapshot only by wall-clock date.

license_policy.version_safety_rule: Bulk payload publication is fail-closed to records with exactly one arXivRaw version. This makes the one OAI license field unambiguous for the only source version. Multi-version papers remain available for indexing/linking but are not redistributed until a reproducible per-version license source is integrated.
license_policy.publication_partitioning: Before Internet Archive publication, partition permitted rows by observed license class so ShareAlike and attribution obligations are explicit and no mixed-license item obscures per-row rights.
license_policy.raw_source_policy: Do not mirror arXiv source packages in Atlas Internet Archive items. Publish only permitted derived occurrence Parquets and lightweight manifests, preserving article/version URL and observed license on every row.

occurrences.input: locally verified arXiv S3 source TAR chunk(s) plus transient metadata JSONL
validation: Every emitted expression is explicitly present in TeX source
Every emitted article has exactly one arXivRaw version
Every emitted article has a recognized CC BY, CC BY-SA, or CC0 license
source_record_sha256 is independent of local checkout/root location
No OCR, macro expansion, algebraic equivalence, or reconstruction is claimed
